steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In November 2022, Equity Mates described Jumia as a pan-African e-commerce player that built out a payments infrastructure, likening it to Amazon or MercadoLibre for Africa. It was framed as shaping up to be an African super app.

episode.title: Everyone makes mistakes. We just make a lot of them.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In November 2022, Equity Mates highlighted the African growth opportunity Jumia targeted, noting a 1.4 billion population and Pew data that just 41% of sub-Saharan Africans had internet or smartphone access. The low penetration was presented as room for long-term expansion.

episode.title: Everyone makes mistakes. We just make a lot of them.
